ticks.note: The button is already held when the charts start. `Edges` reports a rising edge: in tick 1, `pre(button)` is `false`. `PressEvents` passes through `Start`, whose transitions are immediate, straight to `Down`, and emits nothing: a button that is already down is not a new press.
Held: no edge in either chart.
Released. `Edges` computes `fall` (and `change`); `PressEvents` emits `fall` on its way from `Down` to `Up`.
Held: however long the press lasts, each edge lasts one tick.
Released after a press of one tick: `fall`. From tick 2 on the two charts agree; only tick 1 differs.
